<h2>Prepare a Verified Calibration Evidence Migration</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Migrates content-matched calibration evidence without refitting models.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>prepare_sjsdm_cv_calibration_result_migration(
  list_result,
  list_prepared_folds,
  config_model_fitting,
  list_legacy_prepared_folds = NULL,
  migrated_at = base::Sys.time()
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="list_result">list_result</code></td>
<td>
<p>Accepted saved calibration result.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_prepared_folds">list_prepared_folds</code>, <code id="config_model_fitting">config_model_fitting</code></td>
<td>
<p>Current production fold records and structural model configuration.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_legacy_prepared_folds">list_legacy_prepared_folds</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional independently reconstructed original folds for operational-only
version-four migration. Exact original and current analytical proof is
required by [validate_sjsdm_cv_calibration_evidence()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="migrated_at">migrated_at</code></td>
<td>
<p>Explicit timestamp for the migration provenance.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>This function does not write files. Callers must archive the original
evidence before saving its result. An already-current result is unchanged.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A migrated result preserving fitting evidence and prior history.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
prepare_sjsdm_cv_calibration_result_migration(result, folds, config_model)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
